name: portfolio-icons
title: Icons
description: A collection of reusable brand and interface SVG icons.

files.content:
interface IconProps {
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  className?: string;
}

const getSizeValue = (size?: number | string): string => {
  if (!size) return "80px";
  return typeof size === "number" ? `${size}px` : size;
};

export function ui({ width = 80, height = 80, className }: IconProps = {}) {
  const w = getSizeValue(width);
  const h = getSizeValue(height);

  return (
    <svg
      width={w}
      height={h}
      viewBox="0 0 400 400"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      className={className}
    >
      <g clipPath="url(#clip0_ui)">
        <path d="M106 88H266V248H106V88Z" stroke="#2B4FFF" strokeWidth="2" />
        <path
          d="M136 118H296V278H136V118Z"
          stroke="#2B4FFF"
          strokeOpacity="0.5"
          strokeWidth="2"
        />
        <path
          d="M106 88L136 118M266 88L296 118M266 248L296 278M106 248L136 278"
          stroke="#2B4FFF"
          strokeOpacity="0.3"
        />
        <path
          d="M201 223C223.091 223 241 205.091 241 183C241 160.909 223.091 143 201 143C178.909 143 161 160.909 161 183C161 205.091 178.909 223 201 223Z"
          fill="#2B4FFF"
          fillOpacity="0.2"
          stroke="#2B4FFF"
          strokeWidth="3"
        />
      </g>
      <defs>
        <clipPath id="clip0_ui">
          <rect width="400" height="400" fill="white" />
        </clipPath>
      </defs>
    </svg>
  );
}

docs: Imported from the portfolio project. Customize personal copy, links, social profiles, booking URLs, and data before use. Requires React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn theme variables. Files install under your components alias in lazy-ui/, with their relative imports preserved. Import the installed lazy-ui/styles/portfolio.css in your global stylesheet. For Base UI animation utilities, also import shadcn/tailwind.css.
